ev.q: Survival probability was significantly lower among children born to women with HIV infection (94.7%)
Kaplan-Meier survival analyses were used to estimate overall survival and HIV-free survival probability
Cumulative probability of survival up to 3 years among children born to mothers with HIV infection was 94.7%
HIV-free survival probability in children born to mothers with HIV infection was 85.3%.
The cross-sectional nature of the data precludes attribution of results to different HIV program effects.

methods_quotes.q: Kaplan-Meier survival analyses were used to estimate overall survival and HIV-free survival probability
To estimate survival, children were censored at the age at death or age at time of survey.
A sensitivity analysis was conducted to estimate HIV-free survival rates after excluding children currently breastfeeding
